reading.subgroups: 4 groups × 5 questions; 2 changes in each group

items.concept: 一般现在时一般疑问句助动词 Do（主语 you），like doing

replacements.old: (    ) 1. ______ you like playing on the playground?

items.concept: 一般过去时 be 动词单数 Was；be scared of
Does 后接动词原形 find
动词后人称代词宾格 her（双宾语句型）
一般过去时 had 陈述句；a + 单数食物名词、some + 饮品；and 连接
items.answer: She had a banana and some juice.

replacements.old: had/ sandwich/ a/ and/ milk/ some/ I / .
replacements.new: had/ banana/ a/ and/ juice/ some/ She/ .

items.concept: Did + 主语 + 动词原形的一般过去时一般疑问句；have fun
items.answer: Did she have fun at school?

replacements.old: have/ school/ you/ fun/ Did/ in/ ?
replacements.new: have/ school/ she/ fun/ Did/ at/ ?

items.concept: when 引导时间状语从句；阅读上下文时序

replacements.old: Greg and Danny wanted a quiet pet   1   they were 70. But they got Giotto. He is very active. When Giotto first   2   people skateboarding in the park, he was so excited.
replacements.new: Greg and Danny were 70   1   they got Giotto. They wanted a quiet pet, but he is very active. When Giotto first   2   people skateboarding in the park, he was so excited.

items.concept: for 表示受益对象（为 Giotto 做滑板），原考点与选项不变

replacements.old: They bought a cheap skateboard   3   Giotto. Soon they found kid’s skateboards were not good for dogs’ paws. So Greg made a new strong board just for Giotto.
replacements.new: They bought Giotto a cheap skateboard. Soon they found kid’s skateboards were not good for dogs’ paws. So Greg made a new strong board   3   Giotto.

items.section: Part 3 II 长颈鹿阅读选择
items.concept: 定位数字信息；how many 提问数量，原群体数量替换为进食小时数

replacements.old: (    ) 3. How many giraffes are there in a group usually?
replacements.new: (    ) 3. How many hours do giraffes eat every day?

items.section: Part 3 II 长颈鹿阅读选择
items.concept: 定位身体部位与功能的关系；仍考长颈帮助取得高处树叶

replacements.old: (    ) 4. What helps giraffes get high leaves?
replacements.new: (    ) 4. How do giraffes get leaves high up in trees?

replacements.old: A. Their long necks B. Their long legs C. Their big feet
replacements.new: A. With their long necks B. With their long legs C. With their big feet

items.section: Part 3 III 全运会阅读判断
items.concept: 核对吉祥物原型动物的明确事实；更改陈述使答案从 F 变为 T

replacements.old: (    ) 2. The mascots are from American white dolphin.
replacements.new: (    ) 2. The mascots are from the Chinese white dolphin.

items.section: Part 3 III 全运会阅读判断
items.concept: 核对头部水形图案特征的明确事实；从形状核对改为颜色核对

replacements.old: (    ) 4. There are three spots on the mascots’ heads.
replacements.new: (    ) 4. The three water shapes on the mascots’ heads are the same colour.

items.section: Part 3 IV 香蕉车阅读选择
items.concept: 定位数字信息（制作年数换为载客人数），无推理层级变化

replacements.old: (    ) 1. How long did Steve spend making the banana car?
replacements.new: (    ) 1. How many people can the banana car take?

replacements.old: A. One year B. Two and a half years  C. Three years
replacements.new: A. Three people B. Four people C. Five people

items.section: Part 3 IV 香蕉车阅读选择
items.concept: 定位人物活动的明确细节（免费乘车换为购物内容）

replacements.old: (    ) 2. What can people do in Steve’s banana car?
replacements.new: (    ) 2. What does Steve buy when he drives to the shop?

replacements.old: A. Have lunch B. Watch animals C. Have a free ride
replacements.new: A. Fresh bananas B. Toy cars C. New clothes

note: 所有替换的段落编号均基于 //w:body//w:p（包含嵌套文本框段落），从0计数。只改上述范围；不改听力、图片填词及作文。保留原阅读文章，只有完形第1、3小题需局部改变文章句式和空格位置。
quality_notes: 第II阅读Q3保留原选项6–12/14–19/16–20，新答案改为C；第IV阅读Q1答案仍B，但数值信息由年数改为人数。
全文已有原始语病例如听力Where lost the phone?与kid’s skateboards，非本次修改范围；本方案不额外扩张改题数。
若需极严格保持阅读每题事实知识点，可以把II第3、IV第1、IV第2改为同一事实的等难度问法；当前方案保持阅读能力考点不变，增加题目新颖性。
